texts.label: Ferducci to Ferdinand I, Fiume, 19 July 1532 (HHStA Türkei I 2-2-19)
texts.summary: A spy’s letter from the Ragusa network during Süleyman’s campaign: written in clear, it enciphers only eight words — names of people and places, the date and the signature. Once these groups are read, it reveals a plan: to seize the French ambassador at sea on his way back from the sultan.
